svg.title: Training loss on the plane through two trained networks and the bend point
svg.desc: A heat map of the training loss. Both networks sit in low-loss valleys; the straight line between them crosses a high-loss ridge, while the two-segment path through the bend point stays in low loss.
svg.text: Training loss on the plane through A, B and the trained bend point (log colour scale)
dashed: straight line; solid: path through the bend point. Colour: light = low loss, deep orange-red = loss of 3 or more.
